says: The plan says I1 to I6 run before the review in CI's full run on the branch, but under 0602 a branch's full run runs only the tooling project, so those laws and N5 run before merge only by hand.
proof: .github/workflows/scheduled.yaml:282 sets PROJECTS to '--project tooling --project tooling-integration' only when github.ref is refs/heads/main, else '--project tooling'; scripts/typecheck.integration.test.ts holds I1 to I6 and N5.
cost: A later step reading the plan expects CI to prove the real-process laws on the branch, and none does.
